title: Roasted Herb Baby Potatoes
ingredients: 8.1 oz baby potatoes, washed and halved
0.07 oz dried thyme and 0.07 oz dried rosemary
0.14 oz salt and a pinch of black pepper
description: The most beloved side dish, quick and foolproof. These potatoes develop a fragrant, crispy crust while maintaining their signature moist and sweet interior.
instructions: After washing the baby potatoes thoroughly, cut them in half to expose the white flesh to the hot air.
Place them in a bowl and coat with olive oil, stirring well.
Add the garlic powder, dried herbs, salt, and pepper, and toss again so that every potato half is properly seasoned.
Place the potatoes in the air fryer drawer preheated to 383°F and set the timer for 20 minutes.
Remove and shake the basket halfway through cooking (after 10 minutes) to ensure perfectly even browning.
tip: Place the potato halves with the cut side facing up to maximize golden browning.

title: Whole Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large, firm, and fleshy bell peppers (approx. 23 oz total)
0.34 fl oz neutral oil for coating
description: A phenomenal technique for peeling the tough skin off bell peppers. Under the thermal shock, the vegetable wilts and blackens externally, revealing a succulent pulp ready for your recipes.
instructions: Carefully wash the whole bell peppers under running water and dry them by rubbing with a kitchen towel.
Lightly grease them by rubbing a thin layer of oil between your hands and stroking the glossy surface of the vegetables.
Place them whole at the bottom of your air fryer basket and set the temperature to a very high 400°F.
Cook for about 26-30 minutes, making sure to open halfway through and flip them over with tongs.
Remove from the air fryer once withered and slightly charred, place them in a paper bag for 10 minutes, and the skin will peel off in an instant.
tip: Placing them in a closed bag (or a pot with a lid) uses the pepper's residual steam to definitively detach the bitter outer skin.

title: Air Fried Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 sweet white onion, cut into 0.5-inch thick rings
0.07 oz smoked paprika and 0.18 oz salt
description: The quintessential American appetizer. A rich, spiced breading that delivers perfect, extra-crispy rings without the deep-fry oil bath.
instructions: Slice the onion horizontally into thick discs and gently separate the layers with your thumbs to create individual rings.
Set up your breading station: the first bowl with flour; the second bowl with eggs beaten together with the buttermilk; the third with breadcrumbs, salt, and paprika.
Dredge the rings in flour, shake off the excess, dip them in the wet mixture, and finally bury them in breadcrumbs, pressing lightly to ensure adhesion.
Arrange them in the basket in a single layer (work in batches if necessary) and spray generously with oil.
Cook at 375°F for 10 minutes per batch, until your desired level of golden brown is achieved.
tip: Place the breaded rings in the freezer briefly for 5 minutes before cooking: this firms up the egg and secures the coating to the vegetable.
keywords: frying, fried, crispy, tasty, savory, snack, appetizer, side dish

title: BBQ Candied Bacon Strips
ingredients: 0.04 oz ground cumin and 0.04 oz cayenne pepper
description: A bold breakfast or an extreme appetizer: the bacon fat melts the sugar and spice mix, creating a crispy, lacquered strip with a smoky aftertaste.
instructions: Cut each long slice of bacon into two equal parts to make them fit more comfortably.
In a small bowl, mix the brown sugar and all the warm, spicy powders.
Vigorously rub the pork slices into the aromatic mixture, ensuring they are coated everywhere.
Arrange them spaced out inside the warm air fryer basket (not scorching hot, to avoid burning the sugar instantly).
Cook at a medium heat of 320°F for 8 minutes and let them cool for a minute so they harden as they caramelize.
tip: Monitor the cooking at the six-minute mark, as brown sugars in an air fryer go from caramelized to burnt very quickly.

title: Sweet and Mustard Crusted Steaks
ingredients: Coarse sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper
description: Surprise yourself with air-fried steak: the intense heat sears the meat and instantly melts the sweet rub, forming a formidable aromatic crust.
instructions: Take the meat out of the refrigerator half an hour before cooking so it reaches room temperature for even cooking.
In a small container, combine the sugar, mustard powder, coarse salt, and cracked pepper.
Generously coat both sides of the juicy steaks, pressing the dry rub firmly into the meat with your palms.
Place the meat on the preheated air fryer rack.
Set the air fryer to 400°F and cook for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through. At 8 minutes, you will achieve medium doneness.
tip: High initial heat seals all the precious juices inside the structure of the meat, preventing it from drying out.

title: Winter Brussels Sprouts with Pancetta
ingredients: 10.6 oz small Brussels sprouts (washed, trimmed, and halved)
2 thick slices of smoked pancetta, diced
0.07 oz garlic powder, salt, and pepper
description: Rediscover this Nordic vegetable with a delicious technique: the outer leaves char and sizzle, absorbing the savory fats released by the diced pork during cooking.
instructions: Place the halved Brussels sprouts in a large bowl and add the diced pancetta.
Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with garlic powder, fine salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture into the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 400°F for 9 minutes (shake the basket halfway through to prevent the thin outer leaves from burning).
Transfer the steaming vegetables to a serving bowl and immediately sprinkle with the grated cheese.
tip: Always halve the small, firm vegetables to drastically reduce cooking time and ensure they become tender throughout.

title: Crispy Kale Chips
ingredients: 0.3 fl oz vegetable oil or olive oil spray
description: In just a few minutes, transform a hearty winter vegetable into airy, crispy clouds. The ultimate modern healthy snack that is light and crunchy.
instructions: Carefully remove the leafy parts of the kale from the tough, thick central stems and discard the stems.
Dry the leaves thoroughly with paper towels until completely moisture-free, then lightly massage them with a small amount of oil.
Spread the kale in a single layer in the air fryer basket, avoiding overcrowding to ensure proper air circulation.
Air fry at 300°F, tossing the delicate leaves halfway through the cooking time.
Remove from the air fryer and season with sea salt before serving while crispy.
tip: The key to success is ensuring the kale is completely dry before cooking; this prevents steaming and guarantees a perfect, crispy texture.
keywords: vegetables, side dish, vegetarian, quick, easy, fast

title: Dehydrated Thin Apple Slices
ingredients: Freshly squeezed juice from half a yellow citrus (lemon)
description: The slow, long, and absorbent magic of low-heat air dehydration transforms the fleshy, sweet, refreshing fruit into a tough, healthy, dried snack to munch on peacefully while watching videos.
instructions: Wash and peel the apples before coring them, discarding the woody, indigestible seeds.
Use a precision mandoline or sharp knife to slice the apples into dozens of thin, uniform slices approximately 3mm thick.
Dip them briefly in cold water mixed with lemon juice to prevent unsightly oxidation, then pat dry thoroughly.
Place them in the air fryer basket in a single layer, separating them as much as possible.
Set the temperature to 175°F and let them dehydrate until crispy (for a total time of 4 hours).
tip: For perfect dehydration, slice them to a consistent 3mm thickness using a mandoline; the result will be perfectly crisp and brittle.

title: Rustic Country-Style Pear Tart
ingredients: 3.5 oz all-purpose white flour (3.2 oz for dough and 0.35 oz for dusting)
1 large fresh pear, peeled and thinly sliced
0.2 oz cornstarch and 1 oz brown sugar
description: A messy and artistic elegant galette, a sweet delicacy with rustic, crispy edges, gently sweetened by a soft, warm, fruity winter heart packed in sticky honey and crunchy walnuts.
instructions: Combine 3.2 oz of flour with a pinch of salt and cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the cold water, mix briefly to form a dough, wrap it in plastic, and let it rest in the refrigerator for one hour.
In a bowl, mix the sliced pears with the starch, brown sugar, and aromatic spices.

Roll out the dough into a disk about 8 inches in diameter. Place the fruit mixture in the center and fold the edges of the dough up and over the fruit to form a crust. Brush the edges with beaten egg and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Bake at 320°F for 45 minutes and garnish with honey and toasted walnuts before serving.
tip: Brush the edges of the crust generously with beaten egg and sprinkle with raw brown sugar; this will create a beautiful golden crust when baked.
keywords: dessert, sweet, breakfast, snack

title: Crispy Roasted Green Beans
description: Achieve incredible, crisp tenderness in a single bold step. By cooking these sweet, slender pods at a high temperature, you eliminate unwanted moisture and transform them into a delicious, roasted, and crunchy side dish.
instructions: Trim the tough ends off the green beans and discard them.
In a bowl, toss the green beans with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated and glossy.
Place the beans in the preheated air fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry at 400°F for 12-14 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through to ensure even browning and crispiness.
tip: Make sure to thoroughly dry the green beans after washing. Any excess water will cause them to steam rather than crisp, ruining the desired crunchy texture.
keywords: side dish, vegetables, healthy, quick, easy, crispy, air fryer

title: Spherical and Spiced Middle Eastern Chickpea Balls
ingredients: Handfuls of chopped fresh parsley and cilantro
Cumin powder and crushed garlic cloves
description: A wonderful, healthy, low-fat alternative to the classic deep-fried fast-food version. These falafel maintain a creamy, spiced interior while featuring a perfectly crispy, golden-brown crust.
instructions: Pulse the boiled chickpeas in a food processor with the herbs, spices, and tahini, being careful not to turn the mixture into a fine puree.
Finely dice the onions and garlic, then fold them into the chickpea mixture, pressing firmly until you have a compact, fragrant dough.
Shape the mixture into small, firm spheres using your palms, ensuring they are smooth and free of cracks.
Place the balls in the air fryer basket, spacing them apart. Lightly mist them with oil and cook at 340°F for 15 minutes, turning them halfway through for even browning.
tip: Lightly spray each falafel with a fine mist of oil before cooking; this ensures they achieve a beautiful, deep golden-brown color and a satisfying crunch that mimics deep-frying.
keywords: frying, fried, crispy, tasty, appetizer, quick, easy, fast

title: Greek Fries with Feta and Oregano
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or vegetable oil
Fresh chopped parsley and oregano to taste
Salt and black pepper to taste
description: An irresistible side dish with a Mediterranean twist: hot, crispy fries meet the saltiness of feta and the aroma of fresh oregano. Perfect as an appetizer or a delicious side.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into regular sticks and soak them in a bowl of cold water for 15 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain the potatoes, rinse them under running water, and pat them dry meticulously with paper towels (this is the secret to making them crispy!).
In a large bowl, toss the dried potatoes with oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper, mixing well to coat evenly.
Preheat the air fryer to 383°F. Place the potatoes in the basket and cook for 25-28 minutes. Remember to shake the basket vigorously every 10 minutes for perfect browning.
Transfer the sizzling fries to a serving bowl and immediately garnish with crumbled feta, fresh parsley, and oregano.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges for a touch of acidity.
tip: Add the feta and herbs only AFTER removing the fries from the basket, otherwise the excessive heat will melt the cheese too much, causing it to fall to the bottom.

title: Crispy Curly Fries
description: The most fun and delicious fry shape ever. By cooking them straight from the freezer in the air fryer, you will get golden, super crispy spirals in just a few minutes, without adding a drop of oil.
instructions: Pour the frozen curly fries directly into the air fryer basket.
Do not add oil: since this is a pre-fried product, they will release enough during cooking to get golden brown.
Cook at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Shake the basket vigorously halfway through cooking (and again 5 minutes before the end if necessary) to separate any stuck spirals and ensure even browning on all sides.
tip: Do not overfill the basket: curly fries take up a lot of volume and need space for the hot air to circulate in the center of the pile.

title: Crispy Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 6 sheets of brick pastry or very light phyllo dough
1 egg yolk for brushing and olive oil
description: Triangular parcels of oriental inspiration, filled with sweet vegetables and savory cheese, sealed in a pastry sheet that becomes crunchy with every bite.
instructions: Rinse the cauliflower florets, add them to the peas, and soften the vegetables beforehand using a steamer or in a simple pan.
Transfer the cooked vegetables to a bowl and mash them together with the crumbled feta, salt, and pepper to obtain a coarse, rustic mixture.
Cut the brick pastry sheets in half, place a heaping spoonful of vegetables on one side, and fold repeatedly into triangles to seal the filling.
Use the lightly beaten egg yolk to glue the final edge of the pastry, then brush each triangle with olive oil.
Cook them in the air fryer basket for 15 minutes at 340°F, turning them halfway through to brown both sides.
tip: If the vegetable filling is too watery, pat it dry slightly so you don't wet or tear the pastry shell.

title: Banana and Mascarpone Cake
ingredients: 3 very ripe and blackened sweet bananas
description: A fantastic, dense cake perfect for your pantry. Using very ripe fruit creates a rich, intense, and fruity batter, wonderfully contrasted by the silkiness of the mascarpone.
instructions: Peel the bananas and mash the flesh vigorously with a fork until it turns into a rustic batter.
Whisk in the dark brown sugar and sunflower oil until well combined.
Sift the self-rising flour and incorporate it gradually using a spatula, then fold in the chopped walnuts.
Pour the thick batter into a cake pan sized to fit comfortably in the air fryer basket.
Bake gently at 320°F for about 35 minutes, remove, let it cool, and then frost the top generously with the sweet mascarpone.
tip: Check the center of the cake towards the end of baking by inserting a toothpick; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready to be removed.

title: Whole Breaded Mushrooms
ingredients: 10.6 oz whole or quartered mushrooms (pre-breaded and frozen)
description: The fastest side dish or appetizer you can imagine. These go from icy morsels to piping hot treasure chests of flavor in record time.
instructions: Take the breaded mushrooms directly from the freezer bag without letting them soften by thawing.
Arrange them comfortably in a single layer on the bare bottom of your air fryer basket.
There is no need to add oil as the product already contains the necessary fats on the outside for cooking.
Start cooking at 375°F, calculating a time between 15 and 18 minutes to ensure a perfect shell.
At about 8 minutes, open quickly and shake the drawer vigorously so that they move for a masterful browning on every side.
tip: Categorically avoid the thawing stage to prevent water from irremediably ruining the precious bread crust. Remember to shake the basket halfway through cooking.

title: Cheesy Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: The quintessential classic American fast-food toasted sandwich. The air fryer will seal the outer butter, creating a stunning, super-crispy golden crust.
instructions: Preheat your air fryer to 320°F.
Brush one side of each bread slice generously with the melted butter.
On the non-buttered sides, place the slices of sharp Cheddar cheese and assemble the sandwiches, pressing down gently.
Place the sandwiches in the air fryer basket and toast.
Flip the sandwiches halfway through at the 4-minute mark for a total cooking time of 8 minutes, until golden brown. Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
tip: Brush the butter exclusively on the outer sides of the bread to ensure the formation of a formidable golden crust in the hot air.

title: Fiery Cajun-Style Shrimp
ingredients: 16 oz of plump, peeled, and deveined shrimp
0.2 oz of fine sea salt crystals

A bold pinch of dried garlic and aromatic thyme
description: Small, tender, and packing a fiery spicy punch. Perfect for filling tacos and sizzling flatbreads, offering an intense, exotic, and savory kick.
instructions: Quickly rinse the shrimp under water and pat them thoroughly dry with paper towels to ensure they are receptive to the spices.
Place the shrimp in a bowl and toss them evenly with the olive oil and the spicy, smoky seasonings.
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F before adding the shrimp.
Spread the shrimp in a single layer in the basket and cook for 5 minutes, remembering to shake the basket halfway through for even cooking.
Remove from the air fryer and finish with a squeeze of fresh citrus juice to balance the spicy Cajun heat.
tip: Do not overcook, as this can make the shrimp rubbery and tough. Shake the basket halfway through cooking.

title: Roasted Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 large fresh ear of yellow sweet corn
0.5 oz of softened or melted butter
description: A rustic recipe with country flavors, quick to serve as an exceptional sweet and salty side dish for grilled meats or original summer snacks.
instructions: Remove the husks and silk from the corn, then cut it in half to create two equal pieces.
Generously brush the corn kernels all over with the melted butter and sprinkle with salt.
Place the corn into the air fryer basket and start the cooking process at 400°F.
Cook for 10 minutes, making sure to turn the corn halfway through to ensure even browning and a delicious golden finish.
tip: Rotate the corn halfway through the cooking time to ensure it is evenly toasted and aromatic on all sides.

title: Homemade Pepperoni Mini Pizzas
ingredients: 2 round pre-made pizza dough crusts (approx. 7 inches)
Light coating of high-quality oil for brushing the base
6 oz mozzarella, shredded or torn into small pieces
1.8 oz finely grated Grana Padano cheese
description: Quick to make and incredibly delicious: the air fryer toasts the dough first, creating a crispy base capable of supporting the toppings without getting soggy.
instructions: Brush the flattened dough rounds with a thin layer of oil and preheat the air fryer to 320°F.
Place the plain dough into the air fryer basket and toast for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the hot crust, spread with the tomato sauce, and cover with the shredded mozzarella and grated cheese.
Top with the pepperoni slices, distributing them evenly over the cheese.
Return to the air fryer and cook for an additional 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
tip: Always pre-bake the dough before adding the sauce and toppings to prevent the base from becoming soggy.

title: Roasted Garlic and Parmesan Baguette
description: A perfectly crispy crust combined with a soft, buttery center makes this a timeless and irresistible snack, perfect for pairing with hearty soups.
instructions: Slice the baguette lengthwise, then cut crosswise into even, thick pieces to create a sponge-like surface for absorption.
In a small bowl, mix the butter, olive oil, grated Parmesan, and minced garlic until well combined.
Spread the garlic butter mixture generously and evenly over the surface of each bread slice.
Place the bread into the air fryer basket and cook at 320°F for 8 minutes until golden and crispy.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.
tip: Spread the garlic butter mixture generously before air frying; the heat will melt it into the bread's pores, ensuring a perfect, crispy texture.

title: Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 tbsp (0.5 oz) extra virgin olive oil
description: A simple and rustic way to achieve explosive crunch, golden browning, and sweet, fragrant notes from farm-fresh corn.
instructions: Husk the corn, removing all the leaves and the silky fibers. Wash the cobs and pat them dry.
Rub the cobs thoroughly with the olive oil to coat them evenly, then sprinkle generously with the coarse sea salt.
Place the cobs in the air fryer basket in a single layer, ensuring they do not overlap so the hot air can circulate freely for an even, golden-brown roast.
Air fry at 400°F for 12 to 15 minutes, flipping the cobs halfway through the cooking time for an even char.
tip: Make sure to remove all husks and silks before oiling. Turning the corn frequently ensures a perfect, even, and slightly charred finish on all sides of the sweet kernels.

title: Mexican-Style Puff Pastry Wreaths
ingredients: 2 pre-made soft puff pastry discs (approx. 6.7 inches diameter)
Extra virgin olive oil for brushing
4.2 oz of zesty Mexican-style sauce (sweet and spicy)
6 oz of shredded Mexican cheese blend (e.g., Cheddar, Monterey Jack)
1.4 oz sweet corn kernels (thawed) and 2.1 oz black beans, mixed with a small handful (0.5 oz) of peas
description: A brilliant fusion that combines a crispy Italian leavened crust with a festive Tex-Mex soul, featuring black beans, golden corn, and aromatic melted cheeses on a toasted base for an amazing snack.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 320°F.
Brush the pastry discs lightly with olive oil before placing them in the air fryer basket.
Bake the plain pastry bases for 5 minutes until lightly golden, then carefully remove.
Spread the Mexican sauce over the bases, then top with the shredded cheese, black beans, corn, and peas.
Return to the air fryer and cook for another 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
tip: Strictly add the wet toppings and cheese during the final 5 minutes of cooking; adding them too early will cause the pastry base to become soggy.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Patties
ingredients: 5 oz fresh spinach, sautéed and squeezed dry
1 whole egg (or two tablespoons of starch for a vegan version)
0.07 oz cumin and 0.07 oz sweet paprika
description: Super soft homemade veggie burgers, perfect for sandwiches or as a main dish. The crust gets crispy without absorbing excess fat.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the chickpeas, well-squeezed spinach, spices, salt, pepper, and egg.
Pulse until you have a moldable mixture, but do not over-process (it should maintain a rustic texture).
Transfer to a bowl, add the breadcrumbs, and knead. Shape into 4 large patties with damp hands.
Spray the air fryer basket with oil, place the burgers inside, and lightly spray the tops as well.
Cook at 355°F for 14 minutes, flipping them very gently halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Squeeze the spinach very thoroughly before blending: excess water will make the mixture too soft and impossible to hold together.
keywords: savory, dinner, lunch, plant-based, appetizer, snack, quick, easy, air fryer, vegetarian

title: Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil
description: A light and summery side dish or main course. The zucchini softens gently while the cheese filling puffs up and turns golden on top.
instructions: Wash the zucchinis, cut them in half lengthwise, and gently scoop out the center pulp with a spoon or melon baller to create boats.
Chop the extracted pulp and mix it in a bowl with the ricotta, Parmesan, egg, mint, salt, and pepper.
Lightly brush the inside of the empty zucchini boats with a little olive oil and fill them generously with the ricotta mixture.
Place them in the basket in a single layer and cook at 350°F for about 16 minutes.
Remove from the air fryer when the zucchini is fork-tender and the filling is nicely browned.
tip: Drain the ricotta in a sieve for at least an hour before using, otherwise it will release too much whey and ruin the texture of the filling.
keywords: vegetables, side dish, vegetarian

title: Gratinated Bell Pepper Strips
ingredients: 2 large fleshy bell peppers (red or yellow)
description: A great Mediterranean classic: bell pepper strips turn incredibly sweet under high heat and are topped with a savory, rustic, and crunchy breadcrumb coating.
instructions: Wash the bell peppers, remove the stem, seeds, and internal white membranes. Cut them into wide strips.
In a small bowl, prepare the breadcrumb mixture by combining breadcrumbs with capers, garlic, parsley, salt, pepper, and half of the olive oil.
Arrange the pepper strips in the air fryer basket with the concave side facing up.
Fill each strip with the aromatic breadcrumb mixture and drizzle the remaining olive oil over the top.
Cook at 365°F for 14 minutes, until the peppers are softened and the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
tip: If you love bold flavors, you can add two finely chopped anchovy fillets to the breadcrumb mixture, reducing the amount of salt accordingly.

title: Parmesan Crusted Green Asparagus
description: A lightning-fast recipe to elevate this spring vegetable. The cheese melts with the almond flakes, creating a savory and fragrant crust on the tender stalks.
instructions: Wash the asparagus and remove the woody ends by snapping them off with your hands (they will break at the exact natural point).
Place them in a tray or dish, drizzle with olive oil, and toss gently to coat evenly.
Arrange them in a single layer in the air fryer basket and season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle the Parmesan and almond flakes generously, focusing on the tips.
Cook at 375°F for about 8 minutes, removing them as soon as the cheese forms an amber crust.
tip: Do not overcook to maintain their bright green color and preserve a pleasant crunch.
keywords: vegetables, side dish, vegetarian, quick, easy, fast

title: Roasted Fennel Wedges
ingredients: Coarse salt and black pepper to taste
description: Often eaten raw, roasted fennel transforms, losing its excess anise flavor and revealing a rounded, sweet, and tender taste, brightened by a citrus touch.
instructions: Clean the fennel by removing the tough upper stalks and the outer, more fibrous layers.
Cut them in half and then into regular wedges (about 6-8 wedges per bulb), keeping the base intact to prevent them from falling apart.
Toss them in a bowl with the oil, salt, pepper, and fennel seeds for an enhanced aroma.
Arrange them in a single layer in the basket and cook at 355°F for 15 minutes, flipping them with tongs halfway through the cycle.
Serve immediately, drizzling with fresh lemon juice.
tip: Keep a small portion of the base core intact in each wedge; it is the only way to hold the fennel layers together during cooking.

title: Sweet and Sour Red Onions
ingredients: A pinch of salt and pepper
description: A luxurious and caramelized side dish that pairs beautifully with meats or aged cheeses. The air fryer reduces the liquids, creating a thick, glossy glaze.
instructions: Peel the red onions and cut them into thick wedges or large rings, depending on your preference.
Place the onion pieces in a bowl and add the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, salt, and pepper.
Mix well to dissolve the sugar and coat all the onion pieces with the seasoning.
Pour everything into the preheated air fryer basket at 340°F.
Cook gently for 16 minutes, opening the drawer every 5-6 minutes to stir thoroughly and prevent the sugars from burning at the edges.
tip: Frequent stirring is vital for this recipe: brown sugar and balsamic vinegar tend to darken very quickly when exposed to static heat.
keywords: savory, side dish, onions, appetizer, air fryer, vegetarian, gluten-free

title: Balsamic Glazed Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 14 oz Brussels sprouts, cleaned and halved
1.3 tbsp balsamic glaze or thick balsamic vinegar
description: These little green gems turn into a gourmet side dish. The outer leaves roast until crispy, while the insides remain tender under a sweet and tangy glaze.
instructions: Place the halved Brussels sprouts in a bowl and coat them evenly with the olive oil, salt, and a generous amount of pepper.
Arrange them in the bottom of the air fryer basket, setting the machine to 375°F.
Roast for the first 10 minutes, shaking halfway through for perfectly even browning.
In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic glaze and honey.
After 10 minutes, pour the glaze over the Brussels sprouts, shake to coat, and caramelize for the final 2 minutes.
tip: Always add sauces containing honey or sugar only during the final minutes of cooking to achieve a glossy finish and prevent bitter burning.
keywords: side dish, savory, vegetables, quick, easy, healthy

title: Oregano Caramelized Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 14 oz cherry or datterino tomatoes, washed
0.7 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
Salt, pepper, and 1 whole smashed garlic clove
description: The quick version of famous confit tomatoes. Slow drying at a low temperature concentrates sugars and flavors, creating tomato 'candies' that are fabulous for bruschetta.
instructions: Cut all the tomatoes exactly in half and place them in a bowl along with the whole smashed garlic clove.
Season them with olive oil, sugar, oregano, salt, and pepper, tossing gently.
Line the bottom of the air fryer basket with a sheet of perforated parchment paper and place the tomato halves cut-side up.
Start the slow and gentle cooking at 285°F and let them dehydrate and caramelize for 40 continuous minutes.
Carefully remove them, discard the garlic, and store or serve immediately on slices of toasted bread.
tip: Keeping the cut side facing up prevents the tomato juices from spilling to the bottom, concentrating all the flavor inside the skin shell.
keywords: savory, side dish, appetizers, snack

title: Fluffy Seasonal Frittata
ingredients: 3.5 oz of mixed vegetables, sautéed or blanched (zucchini, peas, spinach)
description: A tall and spongy frittata, very easy to unmold. Air frying makes it rise spectacularly while keeping it light and free from the grease of stovetop cooking.
instructions: Whisk the eggs vigorously in a bowl together with the milk, cheese, salt, and pepper until frothy.
Add the pre-cooked vegetables (they must be well-drained) and fold everything together.
